### ✨ New Features

patches.name: Stub App Check tokens
patches.description: Makes Firebase App Check's Play Integrity token fetch succeed with a throwaway token, so the app no longer reports "Device integrity can't be verified". The server still rejects the token, so AI food search keeps failing there. Client-side check only.

patches.name: Unlock Premium (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a re-signed sideload will not work.
